description: Settles an import waiting at the column review, as its review card does: decision approve (the import runs with the confident columns plus keepFields; keepValues and assignValues teach status words) or discard (nothing is written). Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying. An owner-level change: Sergio tells the owner after it is made.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

reason.description: Why you are doing this, in one sentence. The owner sees it in the notice Sergio sends after the change.

name: review_import_mapping
title: Approve or discard a spreadsheet's columns
